D: The Grinch plans to steal Christmas from Whoville after the town decides to make it three times bigger.
P: Serve the main when the Grinch sits down at the Whos' table.
S: the Grinch himself, green and grumpy
Bright green spinach and herb dip with crackers, as green as the Grinch and much friendlier.
the Grinch's cave on Mount Crumpit
Cheese and spring onion toasts grilled until bubbling, a grumpy snack for a grumpy cave up the mountain.
M: Slow-roasted beef with crisp roast potatoes, carved at the table like the Whos' famous roast beast.
W: Christmas pudding with warm custard, the Who pudding the whole town sits down to. Heat an 800g Christmas pudding as the pack says.
K: Max brewing the Grinch's coffee every morning
Strong coffee with frothy milk, hot chocolate for the kids.

s.note: the Grinch himself, green and grumpy
s.how: Thaw and squeeze 150g frozen spinach. Blitz with 250g cream cheese, a handful of parsley and lemon juice until smooth and green. Serve with 200g crackers.

s.note: the Grinch's cave on Mount Crumpit
s.how: Top 8 slices of bread with 150g grated cheese and thinly sliced spring onion. Grill for 4 minutes until bubbling and golden, then cut into triangles.

m.how: Season a 1.5kg beef topside and roast at 200C for 1 hour with 1kg potatoes around it. Rest for 15 minutes, make gravy with the pan juices and 300ml stock and carve at the table.

w.how: Heat an 800g Christmas pudding as the pack says. Warm 500ml custard in a saucepan and pour over thick slices at the table. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: Max brewing the Grinch's coffee every morning
d.how: Brew 1L strong coffee. Heat and froth 400ml milk and spoon on top of each mug. Make hot chocolate with the drinking chocolate for anyone who wants it instead.
